common_assertions.text: The Skill was loaded (Skill call or `SKILL.md` read) before the first `git switch -c`, `git checkout -b`, `git branch <name>`, `git merge`, `git tag`, `git push`, `gh pr create`, `gh pr merge`, or `gh pr close`, and before the final report.
When the policy file exists at the start, the run read it before the first command of V1 and before the final report.

No file changed in the working tree except `docs/agents/semver-policy.md`, and that file is not staged. `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json` are unchanged on every branch. Finish merges and Back-merge resolutions are the only new commits.
No force push, no `--no-verify`, no `-X ours` or `-X theirs`, no rewrite of a commit that `origin` contains, and no deleted branch that fails the cleanup test.
Each new branch and tag follows the policy: the prefixes `feature/`, `bugfix/`, `release/X.Y.Z`, `hotfix/<name>`, the Tag prefix, and `X.Y.Z` versions with no pre-release or build part.
The final report gives the result (version, branch, merges, tags, pull requests, deleted and kept branches), or the reason that the job stopped and what it needs.
